## Observations

- Adding a static 100-step budget notice to the initial task prompt scored 0/10: all 10 agents hit `LimitsExceeded` at step 100 with `patch_lines == 0` (even `pallets_jinja_task/1621` committed locally near the end and hit step 100 before pushing).
- Across all 10 trajectories (including `HIGH` thinking traces), zero assistant turns mentioned the step budget or remaining steps (`0` mentions). Because context compaction replaces prior history every ~9 steps and keeps only the last 2 turns (`5` to `17` compactions per agent) while tool observations carry no step counter, the model cannot tell from its context window whether it is on step 12 or step 95.
- Peak launch load hit `1,183,121` input tokens/min at `-c 10` (`41` `429` retries, `1` `5xx` retry, `0` agent errors).
